name: Dreadmist Peak
summary: Red haze cloaks Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. The Burning Blade cult keeps a hidden refuge on its crags.

sections.title: A Den of Corruption
sections.body: Dreadmist Peak rises above the Barrens, its crags swallowed by a dense red haze that dims the sky. At the crest and in the hollows below, Burning Blade cultists shelter warlocks and toxicologists. They poison nearby water and scheme against the new powers claiming central Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Convergence of Schemes
sections.body: Dreadmist Peak draws more than the Burning Blade. Sarilus Foulborne, a rogue Forsaken mage, has made camp on its heights. He bends elemental forces to corrupt water spirits as far north as Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the air red and foggy around Dreadmist Peak?
faq.answer: No one knows where the reddish-orange fog around Dreadmist Peak comes from. It covers the trails and Dreadmist Den, where Burning Blade warlocks perform their rituals.
The Burning Blade cult controls Dreadmist Peak, watches its trails, and guards Dreadmist Den below. Sarilus Foulborne, a renegade undead mage, also occupies the mountain.

faq.q: How do you reach Dreadmist Peak?
faq.answer: Follow the main road north from the Crossroads to the fork for Ashenvale and Stonetalon. Turn northwest toward the looming crag, then climb the path up its northern face for the safest route to the top.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you investigate Dreadmist Peak's water sources from Camp Taurajo, seeking the unnatural toxins poisoning the gazelles and wildlife of the plains.
As an Alliance agent near Ashenvale, you trace the magic corrupting water elementals to Sarilus Foulborne, an undead summoner on the peak.
